result.title: ThinkMorph-SSL: Scaling Interleaved Multimodal Reasoning with Pretext Tasks
result.summary: People reason with pictures as well as words. Interleaved multimodal reasoning gives models a similar way to solve problems by creating intermediate images and using them to guide further reasoning. Training models with this ability usually relies on task-specific demonstrations, which are difficult to collect. We introduce ThinkMorph-SSL, a two-stage training recipe that uses images themselves as a source of supervision. The first stage, pretext reasoning, converts visual pretext tasks, such as image colorization and denoising, into instruction-free interleaved traces. Models describe a corrupted or transformed image, generate a restored or canonical image, and interpret the result. The second stage uses automatically constructed demonstrations for question-driven instruction tuning. At the same instruction-tuning budget, models trained with pretext reasoning outperform those trained with instruction tuning alone. The full recipe improves over the base model by an average of 11.33 accuracy points across twelve benchmarks. These results show that supervision derived from images can build the visual skills needed for interleaved reasoning and improve learning from task-specific demonstrations.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ThinkMorph-SSL 两阶段训练方案：先用图像上色、去噪等视觉 pretext 任务自动构造无指令的交错多模态轨迹，让模型描述损坏图像、生成恢复图像并解释结果，再用自动构建的示例做问题驱动的指令微调。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接在像素空间生成中间视觉状态引导推理，与「生成」和「轨迹训练/监督来源」主线高度相关；其 pretext 轨迹能否替代昂贵人工示例、以及中间图像是否真正被后续步骤使用，可供核查，但属显式图像而非 latent 状态。
